product.title: Mount Hood Day Trip from Portland to Multnomah Falls and Hood River

description.text: Take a full-day Mount Hood trip from Portland with stops at Multnomah Falls, Hood River, and scenic viewpoints along the Columbia River Gorge. Travel by Mercedes-Benz Sprinter with a local guide, hotel pickup, and time for photos at waterfall and mountain overlooks.

highlights: Full-day Mount Hood and gorge combination from Portland
Stop at Multnomah Falls in the Columbia River Gorge
Visit Hood River and Mount Hood scenic viewpoints
Mercedes-Benz Sprinter transport with hotel pickup
Small-group format with a local guide

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Take a full-day Mount Hood trip from Portland with stops at Multnomah Falls, Hood River, and scenic viewpoints along the Columbia River Gorge.

itineraryItems.title: Multnomah Falls
itineraryItems.description: Begin with a gorge stop at Oregon's iconic two-tier waterfall.

itineraryItems.title: Mount Hood scenic driving
itineraryItems.description: Continue toward Mount Hood with photo stops at mountain viewpoints.

itineraryItems.title: Hood River
itineraryItems.description: Pass through Hood River for riverfront and orchard-country scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Return to Portland
itineraryItems.description: Finish with drop-off at downtown Portland hotels.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
